subject.title: fix(mattermost): preserve text-block boundaries in draft preview (#87322)

question: Should Mattermost `streaming.mode: "block"` and preview-off `blockStreaming: true` intentionally change from one edited preview/final sink to multiple visible posts, and should optional `DraftStreamLoop.takePending` be accepted as the shared helper seam?
rationale: The patch appears to fix the linked message-loss path, but both the PR body and repository policy identify visible delivery shape and plugin/channel API surface as compatibility-sensitive choices that automation should not accept for maintainers.

options.title: Accept This Shape
options.body: Land this PR after maintainer sign-off that multiple Mattermost posts in block mode and the optional draft-loop helper are the desired contract.

options.title: Preserve One-Sink Default
options.body: Ask for a narrower variant that keeps the existing visible sink unless a maintainer-approved opt-in or follow-up policy changes it.

options.title: Decide API Seam First
options.body: Pause until channel/plugin owners decide whether pending-text extraction belongs in `DraftStreamLoop` or should stay Mattermost-local.

recommendation.title: Accept This Shape
recommendation.body: Land this PR after maintainer sign-off that multiple Mattermost posts in block mode and the optional draft-loop helper are the desired contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged and contributed to the original Mattermost draft-preview feature whose visible-sink contract this PR changes.
